newsitem.title: USA: American Comm. says note placement finished.
newsitem.headline: American Comm. says note placement finished.

text.p: American Communications Services said Wednesday it completed the private placement of 13-3/4 percent senior notes due 2007. The notes yield gross proceeds of $220 million.

The company said in a statement that at least $70 million of the proceeds will be placed in escrow and used solely to fund the first five interest payments on the notes or otherwise for the benefit of the notes holders. Interest on the notes will by payable semi-annually in arrears on Jan 15 and July 15. The first payment will begin on Jan 15, 1998.

The telecommunicaitons company, which operates its own local fiber networks said the proceeds from the sale will be used to expand its voice and data network infrastructure and fund negative operating cash flow.
